items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: That was after Lil, you never hear very much of her

ctx.x: He was always friendly with the band, but not buddy buddy with anybody; and during that time, when This was about 1932. I was with him, his wife was a lady named Althea. That was after Lil, you never hear very much of her, but that was in the period in the early thirties.

And I guess I should mention that I got married in Chicago at that time to Irene Armstrong, who had been married to Joe Edqy. Joe Edqy was operating, or the manager of the El Dorado Club on the southside.
